rows.note: This is the all-purpose explicit equivalent when “any” needs to be stated, especially in formal or careful speech.

example.english: Any person can take part in this plan.
example.traditional: 任何人都可以參加呢個計劃。
example.jyutping: jam6 ho4 jan4 dou1 ho2 ji5 caam1 gaa1 ni1 go3 gai3 waak6

rows.note: Use this casual pattern for any person when the sentence says that whoever it is can or will do something.

example.jyutping: bin1 go3 dou1 ho2 ji5 jap6 lei4

rows.note: Use this casual pattern for any thing when the sentence says that whatever it is can or will do something.

example.english: You can eat any food you like.

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun phrase for any person, especially when the person is the focus rather than the choice pattern.

example.jyutping: jam6 ho4 jan4 dou1 ho2 ji5 caam1 gaa1

rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun phrase for any thing, especially when the thing is the focus rather than the choice pattern.
Use this casual construction when the choice is unrestricted or the speaker does not care which item it is.

example.jyutping: si6 daan6 jat1 gaan1 caan1 teng1 dou1 dak1 laa1

rows.note: Use this for an unspecified time that could be very soon, as in someone arriving at any moment.

example.english: You don't need to hurry; they may arrive at any moment.
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 gap1 keoi5 ceoi4 si4 wui5 dou3
